main_text.l: fcripto aduerfus Milleterium, cui Repli-c-
atiomi[?] titulus eft, capite de æqualitate
corruptionis hominum, & in Caluini
defenfione, cap. 13.
In articulo fecundo Arminiani defen-
dunt, Deum, poftquàm ex omni æternita-
te decreuit vnam candemque gratiam
omnibus hominibus offerre, vt in ea vel
recipienda, vel refpuenda vires liberi arbitrij
explicarent, & poftquam præuidit
quinam eam admiffuri effent, qui verò
repudiaturi, ex ea præuisione elegiffe
quos illa gratia bene[?] vsuros effe profpe-
xit, reprobaffe alios. Adeò vt ex eorum
opinione Electio fundata fit in Fidei præ-
uisione.
Orthodoxi verò ftatuunt, tametsi
Deus decreuerit omnes homines ad fi-
dem indifferenter inuitare, fecreuisse
tamen eum in æterno suo consilio cer-
tum quendam numerum hominum à
reliquis, vt illis gratiam quandam singula-
rem indulgeret, per quam inuitationi isti
obsequerentur, & sic perducerentur ad
salutem: Cæteros omnes ab eo in disp-
ensatione illius gratiæ prætermissos esse
tuentur. Addunt prætera cur Deus ita
ageret adductum fuisse vno libertimo[?]

page.notes: The first line of the page continues a paragraph from the previous page. The last line is cut off at the bottom edge of the scan, so "libertimo" is uncertain. "Repli-catiomi" is hyphenated at the line end; the first letter of "catiomi" is unclear. "bene" has a mark over the final vowel that could be a printed abbreviation or damage. The printer uses "effe" and "effent" in the forms shown; these are left as printed.
